searchText: I could see people issuing a 1+5% staked eth token and lock it so it can’t be redeemed and crash the market. Then they can rapidly accumulate eth and gain a large majority? Logically all someone would have to do to gain the network is offer 100% the reward +1% > can rapidly accumulate eth you are assuming people will send them ETH at scale, which is probably not true > Logically all someone would have to do to gain the network is offer 100% the reward +1% You also need to convince depositors that their capital is safe (while actually planning to do something malicious), which is hard.
